svg.text: A gaze that feeds what it rests on, a supply that runs out, and an algorithm that looks when nobody does
it keeps bending and never settles.
your pointer is the gaze point
feeds +26 / s in the feed, +36 / s in the garden
takes over after 60 s with no input
score added when picking the next plant to look at
Choosing what to feed is choosing what to let go.
gains attention; may breed or migrate
grows; a dormant plant wakes up
its path lights up to the power layer
the looked-at video speaks; ambience to 45 %
